scope: Static delta review of the bounded project-identity diagnostic and private facts in existing guard-error envelopes; no live query, inferred project choice or guard relaxation by reviewer.
reviewedDelta: The projectIdentityOnly branch follows the unchanged exact canonical SQL host/port/database/effective and default read-only/repeatable-read/transport guard.
It reads only id/project_number/name for the fixed target UUID with LIMIT2, followed by a fixed parameterized Aalborg/HPU name-or-number discovery query ordered by project_number,id with LIMIT11.
It returns before allowance, selection/model, cable or customer reads. There is no automatic project selection, name rewrite, fallback, or copy-guard relaxation.

Project labels and full observations remain in exclusive private raw output. Public receipts retain raw path/hash, bounded counts and safe guard descriptions only. Raw is durable before host validation; eleven discovery rows produce a retained overflow failure.

Existing normal-copy guard failures may retain only already-selected minimal project identity or model identity/resource-reference facts privately, without extra queries. Public failure metadata remains code-only.
The existing parsed-config/NODE_OPTIONS/no-bootstrap/read-only/startup deadline/output and owner-path safeguards remain applicable.

ownerExecutedChecks.attribution: Source-owner execution; reviewer verified frozen file, receipt and retained output hashes and read the focused tests without rerunning them.

limitations: The cause of SOURCE_PROJECT_IDENTITY is not established by this source review. Original project labels/discovery and model/cable content remain unobserved in the reviewed failed copy.
Actual diagnostic execution remains the parent's sole operation. Any ambiguous/different project observation requires explicit bounded disposition rather than silently changing the source target.
Historical failed copy receipts remain FAIL; a later observation or corrected run cannot relabel them.
